display.purpose: Band and album names, hero/page titles. Ceremony type, the title card.

headline.purpose: Section titles on interior and album pages.

body.purpose: Reading copy, capped near a 34em measure.

label.purpose: Uppercase nav, eyebrows, album-strip titles. Wide tracking is the ornament.

shadows.name: cover-float
shadows.purpose: The single lift in the system, under the hero album cover. Large, soft, warm.

shadows.name: nav-scrim
shadows.purpose: Warm overlay behind the mobile nav menu.

shadows.name: modal-scrim
shadows.purpose: Darkens the page behind the newsletter modal.

motion.name: ease-out-signature
motion.purpose: House ease-out for transforms and reveals (~0.34s). No bounce.

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Color, background, and opacity state changes on links and buttons.

motion.name: overlay-fade
motion.purpose: Newsletter modal toggle. Never display:none, to keep reCAPTCHA mounted.

effects.name: hero-blur
effects.purpose: Frosted album-art background behind the paper scrim.

effects.name: chrome-blur
effects.purpose: Sticky/floating chrome over content. Atmosphere only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Rust action button, uppercase tracked label, sharp poster corners. Deepens to oxblood on hover, no lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #bc3a1e; color: #fff; font-family: 'TASA Orbiter','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.25em; padding: 15px 40px; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #661d1d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #16110d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase tracked text link. Warm-black at rest, fades toward rust on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'TASA Orbiter','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #141210; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 0; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #bc3a1e; }

components.name: Email Input
components.description: Newsletter field. Paper background, warm-black text, hairline stone border, rust focus. (Live site uses a generated Brevo embed; this is the on-brand target.)
components.css: .ds-input-email { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #fff; color: #16110d; font-family: 'TASA Orbiter','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif; font-size: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid #56524d; border-radius: 3px; transition: border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-input-email::placeholder { color: #8a847c; } .ds-input-email:focus { outline: none; border-color: #bc3a1e; }

components.name: Frosted Album-Art Hero
components.description: Signature. Oversized, blurred release artwork behind a top-to-bottom paper scrim; Herqin title over it; album cover floats with the warm cover-float shadow.
components.html: Transmutations
components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; } .ds-hero-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: center/cover no-repeat url('album.jpg'); filter: blur(64px); transform: scale(1.18); } .ds-hero-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,1) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.86) 46%, rgba(255,255,255,0.5) 72%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 100%); } .ds-hero-inner { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 24px; padding: 96px 6vw; } .ds-hero-cover { width: 100%; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 34px 90px rgba(20,12,6,0.32); } .ds-hero-title { font-family: 'Herqin','Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(34px,4.4vw,96px); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: #16110d; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: BALTHVS is a psychedelic trio, and every reflex says 'psychedelic' should mean neon on black. This system does the opposite on purpose. The base is warm paper light, the darks are warm near-black (never neutral), and the atmosphere comes from the band's own artwork, oversized and blurred to a frosted haze behind the type. It should feel like warm daylight through frosted glass at the top of the page, then the lights going down toward a live set as you go deeper into overlays and the newsletter modal. The type does the heavy lifting: a decorative display serif (Herqin) carries every name, band and album, while a clean grotesque (TASA Orbiter) carries the reading. Color is restrained to near-monochrome warmth with two rare sparks (rust and electric indigo) that behave like stage lights, never fields.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-light primary surface with warm near-black darks (#141210), never neutral #000.
The background is always the release's own artwork, blurred and bled to paper.
Herqin display serif for names; TASA Orbiter grotesque for everything read.
Two spark accents (rust #bc3a1e, indigo #3f33d6) used as points, never planes.
Sharp 3px poster radius; one big warm shadow; wide-tracked uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Frosted-Art Rule
rules.body: The atmospheric background is always the current release's own artwork, scaled up (~1.18) and blurred, behind a paper gradient scrim. Never a flat color, stock gradient, or purchased texture. The art is the mood.

rules.name: The Warm-Black Rule
rules.body: Every dark tilts warm (#141210, #16110d, rgba(20,12,6,x) shadows, rgba(10,8,6,x) scrims). #000/#000000 and neutral-gray shadows are forbidden.

rules.name: The Two-Spark Rule
rules.body: Rust and indigo are sparks, not fields. Combined they cover a small fraction of any screen.

rules.name: The Herqin-for-Names Rule
rules.body: Herqin is reserved for names and titles. Never set body, labels, buttons, or UI in Herqin.

rules.name: The Wide-Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase labels are tracked between 2px and 9px; tracking scales with prominence and is the decoration.

rules.name: The One-Float Rule
rules.body: Only the album cover floats. Cards, sections, and buttons stay flat on paper.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: When a shadow exists, its color is rgba(20,12,6,x). Neutral or blue-gray shadows are forbidden.

dos: Do use the release's own artwork, blurred and scrim-veiled, as the page background.
Do keep darks warm: #141210 and the rgba(20,12,6,x) / rgba(10,8,6,x) family.
Do reserve Herqin for names and titles; set everything read in TASA Orbiter.
Do track uppercase labels wide (2px-9px) and let that tracking be the ornament.
Do ease motion out with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
Do cap reading measure near 34em and the layout at the --shell column width.
Do let scale and the touring resume speak plainly; show the reach, do not boast it.
donts: Don't reach for neon-on-black psychedelia (electric purple/cyan on pure black, laser gradients).
Don't signal 'Latin band' with palm-and-neon or tropical-postcard palettes.
Don't let it look like an interchangeable Spotify-for-Artists page or link-in-bio template.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) or decorative glassmorphism cards.
Don't use #000/#000000 or neutral-gray shadows; warm-tint every dark.
Don't add a colored border-left/border-right stripe to cards, list items, or callouts.
Don't add per-card drop shadows to make things pop; only the album cover floats.
Don't set body copy, buttons, or labels in Herqin.
